svg.text: b Many experiments at once, one after another
in parallel: every field of view gets its own light program
live feedback: images can update the light while a run is going
in sequence: each result shapes the next run
run 3 waits for a person to approve it
Each one is written by the agent
d The agent designs, runs and analyzes. A person decides.
measures every cell live, flags surprises
new conditions where the answer is
hours to days, with no one at the microscope
e Every run leaves a full record
The agent also keeps notes on the
lab and each microscope, so a new
session starts with what it needs.
